_readme: Functions granted EXECUTE to `authenticated` that check-dormant-rpcs.mjs must not fail on.
An entry is a debt, not an absolution. The gate exists because this codebase repeatedly shipped
complete server work no button could reach (BACKLOG.md G1-G12). Delete the entry when the caller
lands -- do not delete the entry to make the gate quiet.
Six functions were exposed at once when the gate stopped treating a migration comment as a call
site. Five have since been wired and their entries removed: revoke_offline_service_device,
get_resident_administrative_packet and is_employee_access_active. One remains, below.

unassign_organization_release_cohort.reason: Restored by 20260804160000 to close the one-way door 20260802030000 left behind: that migration dropped the unassign side while keeping assign, so an organization could be put into a release cohort and nothing supported could take it out. The console that called it was deleted on purpose in the same migration and is deliberately not being re-added here. The function is the supported exit; the surface that calls it is the open work.
